answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit tied to a verifiable work-history atlas: before joining a market, it must complete low-value, independently verified tasks over several days, building a public record that cannot be bought in bulk. One fake identity is cheap, but hundreds of credible histories cost time, compute, and repeated fees, while one proven fraud burns the deposit and voids the atlas. Like a lantern crossing a tundra night, each history stays visible, so Sybil clusters sharing timing or funding stand out and can be excluded before they distort prices.
